name: hashid
summary: Identify hash and cipher types before cracking.
description: hashid analyses a hash string and lists the most probable hash algorithms (MD5, SHA-1, bcrypt, etc.), telling you what to feed into a cracker.

options.description: Pass the candidate hash as a positional argument
Also show john the ripper formats

examples.title: Identify a hash
examples.explanation: 64 hex chars strongly suggests SHA-256 family.
